notes: The first block of the list (unheaded) is read as the starting cards: the Objective, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Insurrection, Staging Areas, Strike Planning and Heading For The Medical Frigate; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Total 60 as published.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace' dested the Light site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Han With Gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Leia with Blaster' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando with Axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Beezer' Corporal Beezer; 'Delevar' Corporal Delevar; 'Obi's Stick' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'Luke's Stick' Luke's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Out Of Comission And Transmission Terminated' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Sorry About The Mess + Blaster Proficiency' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'Clash Of Sabres' Clash Of Sabers; Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect (the post calls it 'a token Wise Advice (not combo for destiny)'), not the Reflections III shield.
No result is stated for the Melbourne tournament of 28 January 2001.
player_note: The post says this is 'the Profit deck that I played last tournament that I was asked to post', and points to his tournament report '(Melbourne, 28/01/01 on my page)'; no result is given.
